verdict.rationale: Paddle's hosted MCP server lets an agent build pricing models and chain multiple Paddle API calls in one `execute` invocation. Agent skills cover catalog setup and checkout, and the API can create transactions, so an agent could plausibly provision a catalog and checkout in one session. The evidence never explicitly documents creating products and prices via the API, and never mentions a shareable payment-link object. missing for 10: explicit product/price create endpoints, a documented payment-link or checkout-URL capability, a worked single-session end-to-end example, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent provision a new product, price, and payment link via the API in a single session

citations.quote: Runs a JavaScript async function that chains one or more Paddle API calls in a single invocation
